title: Unnamed Berkeley/MIT inference engine benchmarks vs llama.cpp and Ollama
summary: Promotional thread claiming UC Berkeley and MIT researchers open-sourced a new inference engine running DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s on an RTX 5090, 1.46× faster than llama.cpp, and up to 3× faster than Ollama on Qwen3.6-35B. No repo URL in the captured post.
question_it_answers: What throughput claims were made for the unnamed Berkeley/MIT inference engine?

claims.text: The engine runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s on an RTX 5090 system.
claims.evidence: > runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s with a RTX 5090 system
claims.subject: local-inference-models

claims.text: Reported 1.46× faster than llama.cpp on the same test; Ollama cannot serve that model.
claims.evidence: > 1.46x faster than llama.cpp on the same test. Ollama can’t even serve it
claims.subject: local-inference-models
